description: Fix all non-responsive patterns across every User page (landing, sign-in, sign-up, dashboard, profile, profile-setup, scholarships, matches, saved, my-applications, messages, settings, redirect). This feature is independent of FEAT-001 (it touches only page files, not layouts), so it can be worked on in any order but should be committed after FEAT-001 since pages render inside layouts.
steps: === landing.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\landing.tsx) ===

Issue 1 — Nav bar buttons cramped on mobile: The nav `<div className='flex items-center gap-4'>` with two buttons has no mobile concern since the page is simple. However add `text-sm` shrink safety: the Sign In and Sign Up button labels are already short so no change needed. The hero section `flex gap-3` button group needs `flex-wrap` → change to `flex flex-wrap gap-3`.
Issue 2 — CTA section: `<div className='bg-blue-600 rounded-2xl p-10 flex flex-col lg:flex-row ...'>` p-10 is too large on mobile → change to `p-6 md:p-10`.

Issue 3 — Landing modals have `p-8 w-full max-w-[400px]` which is fine but needs `mx-4` safety → the outer div already has `items-center justify-center`. The modal div uses `w-full max-w-[400px]` — add `mx-4` to prevent edge clipping → change to `className='bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 w-full max-w-[400px] mx-4 shadow-2xl relative'`.
=== sign-in.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\sign-in.tsx) ===

The page wraps with `min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100 p-4`. The inner card has `w-full max-w-md`. The OTP inputs use `w-11 h-14` per box (6 boxes × 44px + gaps = ~300px) which fits in max-w-md. No significant issues. Verify the OTP `flex gap-2 justify-center` is safe — it is. No changes needed.
=== sign-up.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\sign-up.tsx) ===

The sign-up is rendered inside auth-layout which wraps in `max-w-[480px] mx-4`. The `grid grid-cols-2 gap-3` for Google/Microsoft buttons is safe at 480px max. No critical issues. The social buttons grid is only 2 items and each has a short label. No changes needed.
=== dashboard.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\dashboard.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Container: `max-w-4xl mx-auto py-8 px-4` is responsive already.

Issue 2 — Post action buttons: `flex items-center justify-between mt-3` contains `flex gap-2` (Photo/Document buttons) + Post button. On very small screens this can overflow. Wrap the button group `div` with `flex-wrap`: change `<div className='flex items-center justify-between mt-3'>` to `<div className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-3'>`.

Issue 3 — Post like/comment/share/save button row: `flex items-center justify-around` — these 4 buttons must not overflow. Add `flex-wrap` → `<div className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-around gap-1'>`.
=== profile.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\profile.tsx) ===

Issue 1 — Education edit form: `<div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>` appears 3 times (GWA/Education Level, Field/GradYear, School/Campus, School Type/Location). On mobile 320px these 2-col grids are too narrow. Change all occurrences to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4`.

Issue 2 — Profile header banner: The profile page has a fixed `h-32 bg-gradient` banner and an avatar that overflows on very small screens. The avatar is positioned with `-mt-12` and `flex flex-col md:flex-row`. Verify this is in place — in the ProviderProfilePage. In the scholar profile.tsx the header section uses a card with `flex items-center gap-3 mb-1` which is already fine.

Issue 3 — Documents tab: The documents list has `flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg`. On mobile long file names can overflow. Add `min-w-0` to the inner text container and `truncate` to the filename text. Specifically: `{doc.documentType}` → wrap in a div with `min-w-0 flex-1`.
=== profile-setup.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\profile-setup.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Step 1 Location/DOB grid: `<div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>` → change to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4`.
Issue 2 — Step 2 GPA/Education Level grid: `<div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-6'>` → change to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6`.
Issue 3 — Step 3 special categories: `<div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-6'>` (left/right checkbox columns) → change to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4`.
Issue 4 — Step 3 financial info: `<div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-4'>` → `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4`.
Issue 5 — Container padding: `py-12 px-4` is already fine.
=== scholarships.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\scholarships.tsx) ===

Issue 1 — Main layout: `<div className='grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 min-w-0'>` — this is already responsive! The filter aside is `lg:col-span-1` and content is `lg:col-span-3`. This is fine.

Issue 2 — The filter panel sticky card has `sticky top-4` which works on desktop but on mobile `<aside className='lg:col-span-1'>` is not sticky in a grid — it just stacks. This is acceptable behaviour. No change needed.

Issue 3 — The scholarship detail Dialog: `<DialogContent>` uses default shadcn sizing. Ensure it has `max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto` — check the Dialog that shows scholarship details. The apply dialog should have `className='max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto'`. Verify the scholarship detail dialog has this and add if missing.
Issue 4 — Inside the Dialog, the eligibility criteria table: look for any `grid grid-cols-2` patterns and convert to `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2`.
Issue 5 — Page padding: `py-8 px-4` is already responsive.
=== matches.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\matches.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Page padding: `p-6 lg:p-8` — good.
Issue 2 — The rank card horizontal layout: `flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch gap-0` — already responsive.
Issue 3 — Rank number left column: `lg:w-16 w-full lg:min-h-0 min-h-[48px]` — already responsive.
Issue 4 — Middle scholarship card: `w-full lg:w-[280px] shrink-0` — already handles mobile.

Issue 5 — SHAP bars: `w-[110px] shrink-0 truncate` — the factor name is 110px wide. On very small screens, the whole ShapBar flex container needs to wrap gracefully. The `flex items-center gap-2 text-xs` container: add `flex-wrap` → `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs` and remove the fixed `w-[110px]` in favour of `min-w-0 shrink-0 max-w-[100px]`.
Issue 6 — Fallback scholarship cards: `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch` — already responsive.
=== saved.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\saved.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Container: `p-8` → change to `p-4 md:p-8`.
Issue 2 — Saved grid: `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4` — already responsive! No change.
Issue 3 — Card footer `flex items-center justify-between` — on mobile this is fine.
=== my-applications.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\my-applications.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Container: `py-8 px-4` is fine.
Issue 2 — Application card: `flex flex-col md:flex-row` — already responsive.

Issue 3 — `md:size-48 shrink-0` image — on mobile displays as full-width. This is correct but `md:size-48` with `h-full object-cover` may produce a very tall image on mobile. Add `h-48 md:h-auto md:w-48` → change `<div className='md:size-48 shrink-0'>` to `<div className='h-48 md:h-auto md:w-48 shrink-0'>`.
Issue 4 — Inside detail modal: `grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm` (reference number, date, match score, status) → change to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm`.
=== messages.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\messages.tsx) ===

Issue 1 — CRITICAL: The chat layout `<div className='bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4'>` is a hard 3-column grid with no mobile fallback. The conversation list (`col-span-1`) and chat pane (`col-span-2`) will each be ~33% / ~67% of screen width on mobile, making text unreadable at 320px. Fix: Change to `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4`. Then add a mobile toggle: show conversation list when no activeId, show chat pane when activeId is set (mobile-only single-pane view). Specifically: (a) change grid to `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`; (b) on the conversation list div add `className='col-span-1 border-b md:border-b-0 md:border-r pr-0 md:pr-4 pb-4 md:pb-0'`; (c) on the chat pane div add `className='col-span-1 md:col-span-2 hidden md:block' id='chat-pane'` and add a state `const [showMobileChat, setShowMobileChat] = useState(false)`; (d) when a conversation is selected on mobile, show the chat pane by changing display; (e) add a back button in the mobile chat header. Alternatively simpler: on `<768px` the list takes full width and chat is hidden, clicking a conversation hides the list and shows the chat (single-pane); on `>=768px` both show side by side. Implement with `showMobileChat` state.
Issue 2 — Container: `p-8` → `p-4 md:p-8`.
Issue 3 — Header flex: `mb-6 flex items-center justify-between` — fine.
=== settings.tsx (e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\settings.tsx) ===
Issue 1 — Container: `p-8` → `p-4 md:p-8`.

Issue 2 — Account security rows: `flex items-center justify-between py-3` — each row has a label+description on the left and a button on the right. On mobile ~320px the button text ('Configure', 'Manage', 'Update') may be squeezed. Add `flex-wrap gap-2` → `flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-3`.
Issue 3 — Preferences grid: `grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2` — already responsive.
Issue 4 — Dialog modals: `sm:max-w-xl` → add `max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto` to all three Dialogs.
acceptance_criteria: At 320px viewport, all user pages scroll vertically without horizontal overflow.
The messages page shows a single-pane view on mobile: conversation list first, then chat pane after selecting a conversation, with a back button.
All 2-column grids in forms (profile, profile-setup, my-applications modal) stack to single column below sm (480px).
Saved, dashboard, and settings pages have p-4 on mobile and p-8 on md+.
`npm run build` exits with code 0 and no TypeScript errors.
verification: cd 'e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd' && npm run build — must exit 0 with no errors.
findings: All 10 user page responsive fixes implemented and verified. messages.tsx: added showMobileChat state, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3, mobile back button, p-4 md:p-8. dashboard.tsx: flex-wrap on post action buttons and like/comment row. profile.tsx: all grid-cols-2 gap-4 changed to grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 (8 occurrences). profile-setup.tsx: step 1/2/3 grids changed to grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2. matches.tsx: ShapBar label changed from w-[110px] to max-w-[100px] with flex-wrap container. saved.tsx: p-8 to p-4 md:p-8. my-applications.tsx: image div h-48 md:h-auto md:w-48, modal grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2. settings.tsx: p-8 to p-4 md:p-8, security rows flex-wrap gap-2, all 3 Dialogs max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto. landing.tsx: hero buttons flex-wrap, CTA p-6 md:p-10, modals p-6 md:p-8 mx-4. scholarships.tsx: detail Dialog already had max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto, no change needed. Build passes with exit code 0.
